question: Who among the following received the Parishad Samman by the Delhi government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shovana Narayan.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shovana Narayan received the Parishad Samman from the Delhi government.**
 
• ** The Parishad Samman is a prestigious award given by the Delhi government to artists who have made significant contributions to the field of art and culture.**
 
• **Anuradha Pandey** is not the correct answer as she has not received the **Parishad Samman from the Delhi government.**
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** is also not the correct answer as he was a renowned** Odissi dancer and choreographer who passed away in 2004.**
 
• **Vempati Chinna Satyam** is also not the correct answer as he was a famous **Kuchipudi dancer **who passed away in 2002.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Anuradha Pandey is a well-known Kathak dancer and choreographer who has received several awards for her contribution to the field of dance.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra was a renowned Odissi dancer and choreographer who is credited with reviving the classical dance form in the 20th century.
 
• Vempati Chinna Satyam was a famous Kuchipudi dancer and choreographer who is credited with popularizing the dance form across the world.
